samples.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE 0 END AS adjusted_amount FROM APP.orders
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM APP.orders WHERE status = 'A' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
SELECT child.amount FROM APP.orders child JOIN APP.orders parent ON child.parent_order_id = parent.order_id
SELECT o.amount, c.customer_name FROM APP.orders o LEFT JOIN APP.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT status FROM APP.orders) d GROUP BY status
((SELECT customer_id FROM APP.orders UNION SELECT customer_id FROM APP.customers) INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM APP.limits) EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM APP.orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'
SELECT o.order_id FROM APP.orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM APP.customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM APP.limits l WHERE l.customer_id = o.customer_id)
SELECT 1 AS flag FROM APP.orders o CROSS JOIN APP.customers c
SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount FROM APP.orders
SELECT order_id, amount FROM APP.orders ORDER BY amount DESC FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
